6b28e0d879808dd9.reason: fix(device-writer): write UC512/SDI-12 rows through the node db facade. Measured with verify-flows-size-ratchet's nodeSizes over both maintained profiles (byte-identical bcm2712/bcm2709): origin/main 1638 -> HEAD 1866 = +228. 'UC512 Normalize + Write' calls osi-device-writer.writeDeviceData with `new osiDb.Database(...)` from osi-db-helper -- a promise-returning run/get/all/close facade with no `.prepare` -- but the call site never awaited the result, so every real UC512 uplink threw 'db.prepare is not a function' inside the node's own try/catch and wrote no device_data row (caught silently as node.error, no crash, no visible symptom besides missing rows). osi-device-writer's writeDeviceData now dispatches on db shape (db.prepare present -> synchronous node:sqlite path, unchanged; facade shape -> new async path returning a Promise), so this node's body is wrapped in the same `return (async () => { ... await writerRes.value.writeDeviceData(...); ... })();` shape 'SDI12 Normalize + Write' already used. The +228 bytes are the async IIFE wrapper, the added `await` on writeDeviceData and db.close(), and a safer error-message guard on the catch.
